Zuhlsdorf, B. (Operating Agent) et al. (2023). Annex 58 High-Temperature Heat Pumps, Task 1 - Technologies, Task Report. IEA Technology Collaboration Programme on Heat Pumping Technologies (HPT TCP), Heat Pump Centre, Boras, Sweden. Report no. HPT-AN58-2, ISBN 978-91-89821-34-7, August 2023. https://heatpumpingtechnologies.org/content/uploads/sites/70/2023/09/annex-58-task-1-technologies-task-report.pdf

Locators are printed page numbers. Targeted pass on a 173-page report (Ch. 1 working principles, Ch. 2 technology review, Ch. 3 demonstration cases, Ch. 4 country chapters). Main file: all 34 supplier lines of Table 2-2 (capacity, Tmax,supply, supplier-indicated TRL, specific investment cost, p.44-45) as one process each, using heat-pump_industrial (Qpinch as heat-transformer_chemical_qpinch, the same name as in the Ager 2023 extraction); the 18 demonstration cases of Table 3-1 (p.66: capacity, sink outlet temperature, COPH as %, source and sink temperatures and operating hours in other-values), where heat-driven absorption heat transformers (cases 14, 15, 17) are given as heat-transformer technologies; Hybrid Energy models (Table 4-8), SkaleUP (Table 4-9), Enerin HoegTemp (Table 4-10) and Olvondo HighLift (p.132); the Swiss specific investment cost (p.152, reprinted from Wolf et al. 2017). Table 2-2 prints no COPs (only plotted in Fig. 2-35, not loaded). COP is stored as % (COP = %). Tmax,supply is stored as temperature-output (maximum). Not loaded: Tables 4-3 to 4-7 (development targets, not performance), country funding and market tables, figures (charts), points in Fig. 2-32 to 2-36. Pooling: many products overlap Arpagaus et al. (2018) and the Ager (2023) market overview (Kobelco SGH120/SGH165, Mayekawa EcoSirocco, Hybrid Energy, Combitherm, Mitsubishi, Olvondo, Spilling, Piller, Enerin, Epcon, Turboden); the numbers here are the suppliers own 2023 data, kept separately.

(1) Template says specific investment cost is for installed system without integration, Sect. 2.3 text says disregarding installation and integration cost; COST BASIS recorded as installed, flagged. (2) Table 2-3 gives 200-1500 EUR/kW but Sect. 2.3 text gives 200-1200 EUR/kW. (3) Table 2-3 says 85 use cases, text says over 80. (4) Table 3-1 case 13 prints COPH as two values (2.5, 2.3) and two source temperature pairs with no explanation. (5) Table 3-1 case 14 (QPinch) source/sink printed as ranges. (6) Table 2-2 TRL for Siemens Energy is 9 up to 90 degC only; pilot at 120 degC. (7) No price year for any cost; EUR assumed as printed. (8) Specific costs are supplier-provided estimates, some are targets for low-TRL cases.
